_about: Settings used by scripts/compare_png.py. They are mstack's own first choices, not values from a standard, so no outside source can verify them. Change them here, or per run with the script's options, when a project needs a different bar.

channel_tolerance.source: mstack first setting: absorbs font smoothing and image compression noise

region_max_diff_percent.unit: percent of pixels in a region

height_gap_px.unit: px of height difference that still passes
